description: Unit test class for ImmutableFeature, covering creation, immutability, property manipulation, JSON serialization, and other behaviors of the ImmutableFeature class within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior and properties of ImmutableFeature objects.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests that ImmutableFeature properly implements equals and hashCode methods, including prefab values for SoftReference objects.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableFeature instance is immutable, including known immutable types and fields modified during caching.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Verifies that creating an ImmutableFeature with a null feature ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullProperties
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableFeature with null properties and confirms it produces an empty JSON string.

methods.name: createInstanceWithLeadingSlash
methods.description: Ensures that feature IDs with a leading slash throw JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithEndingSlash
methods.description: Ensures that feature IDs with an ending slash throw JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithInbetweenSlash
methods.description: Ensures that feature IDs with slashes in between throw JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: getIdReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getId() returns the correct feature ID.

methods.name: getPropertiesOnFeatureWithoutPropertiesReturnsEmptyOptional
methods.description: Verifies that getProperties() returns empty Optional when no properties are set.

methods.name: getPropertiesReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getProperties() returns the expected properties when set.

methods.name: setPropertiesWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests that setProperties() creates a new Feature with updated properties.

methods.name: removePropertiesWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that removeProperties() removes properties and returns a feature with empty properties.

methods.name: getPropertyFromFeatureWithoutProperties
methods.description: Checks that querying a property from a feature without properties returns empty.

methods.name: tryToGetNonExistingProperty
methods.description: Verifies that querying a non-existent property returns empty.

methods.name: getExistingProperty
methods.description: Verifies that querying an existing property returns the correct value.

methods.name: tryToSetPropertyValueWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Checks that setting a property with a null pointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetPropertyWithNullValue
methods.description: Checks that setting a property with a null value throws NullPointerException with a specific message.

methods.name: setPropertyValueOnFeatureWithoutProperties
methods.description: Tests setting a property on a feature with no properties.

methods.name: setPropertyValueOnFeatureWithExistingProperties
methods.description: Tests updating an existing property.

methods.name: tryToRemoveNonExistingProperty
methods.description: Ensures removing a non-existing property returns the same feature.

methods.name: tryToRemovePropertyFromFeatureWithEmptyProperties
methods.description: Ensures removing a property from a feature with empty properties returns the same feature.

methods.name: removeExistingProperty
methods.description: Tests removing an existing property.

methods.name: jsonSerializationWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the feature serializes correctly to JSON.

methods.name: toStringContainsExpectedKeywords
methods.description: Checks that toString() output contains relevant keywords.

methods.name: ensureFeatureNewBuilderWorks
methods.description: Verifies the builder creates a feature identical to expected.

methods.name: ensureFeatureToBuilderWorks
methods.description: Checks that toBuilder() method preserves feature properties.

methods.name: getDefinitionFromFeatureWithoutDefinitionReturnsEmptyOptional
methods.description: Ensures that getDefinition() returns empty when no definition is set.

methods.name: getDefinitionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates that getDefinition() returns the correct definition.

methods.name: setDefinitionWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests setting a new definition on the feature.

methods.name: removeDefinitionFromFeatureWithoutDefinitionReturnsSameFeature
methods.description: Ensures removing a definition from a feature without one returns same feature.

methods.name: removeDefinitionWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that removeDefinition() removes the definition properly.
